lessons.title: F and J
lessons.intro: Rest your index fingers on F and J. Feel the little bumps? That's home.

lessons.title: D and K
lessons.intro: Middle fingers on D and K. Keep your index fingers on F and J.

lessons.title: S and L
lessons.intro: Ring fingers on S and L. Fingers curl a little, like holding a ball.

lessons.title: A and ;
lessons.intro: Pinkies on A and semicolon. Pinkies are weak at first. That's normal.

lessons.title: G and H
lessons.intro: Index fingers reach sideways to G and H, then come straight back home.
lessons.tip: Reach and return. Home row is home.

lessons.title: Home row words
lessons.intro: Real words with only home-row letters. Say each word as you type it.

lessons.title: R and U
lessons.intro: Index fingers reach up to R and U.

lessons.title: E and I
lessons.intro: Middle fingers up to E and I. These two are everywhere in English.

lessons.title: W and O
lessons.intro: Ring fingers up to W and O.

lessons.title: Q and P
lessons.intro: Pinkies up to Q and P. Slow is fine.

lessons.title: T and Y
lessons.intro: Index fingers stretch up and in to T and Y.

lessons.title: Top and home words
lessons.intro: Two rows unlocked. From here the keyboard dims so your eyes stay on the screen. Tap the toggle if you need a peek.

lessons.title: V and M
lessons.intro: Index fingers reach down to V and M.

lessons.title: C and comma
lessons.intro: Middle fingers down to C and comma.

lessons.title: X and period
lessons.intro: Ring fingers down to X and period.

lessons.title: Z and slash
lessons.intro: Pinkies down to Z and slash. The hardest reach on the keyboard.

lessons.title: B and N
lessons.intro: Index fingers reach down and in to B and N.

lessons.title: Every letter
lessons.intro: All 26 letters unlocked. Words from the whole alphabet.

lessons.title: Shift and capitals
lessons.intro: Hold Shift with the OTHER hand's pinky, then tap the letter. Capital F means right Shift plus F.

lessons.title: Capital sentences
lessons.intro: Short sentences. Capital at the start, period at the end, one space between words.

lessons.title: Numbers 1 to 5
lessons.intro: Left hand reaches to the number row. Pinky 1, ring 2, middle 3, index 4 and 5.

lessons.title: Numbers 6 to 0
lessons.intro: Right hand: index 6 and 7, middle 8, ring 9, pinky 0.

lessons.title: Punctuation
lessons.intro: Apostrophe is right pinky. Question mark and exclamation need Shift.

lessons.title: Graduation
lessons.intro: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Every letter, at your own pace. You made it.
